quests.title: Echoes Below
quests.description: Two sealed caves hum with old light: one in Misty Pinewood, one above Crystal Creek.

steps.text: Enter Whispering Hollow in the south-west of the pinewood (a Bright Lantern lights the way)
Light the braziers in the right order
Slide the stone blocks onto the plates
Find a way across the chasm
Read the Song of the Crystals and make a Crystal Tuner
Wake the Singing Grotto above Crystal Creek

hints: Every cave puzzle has a reset lever, and you can leave a cave whenever you like. Press H inside for hints.
